mapper.select: SELECT session_id, transcript_path FROM execution_session WHERE transcript_path IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_observed_at, session_id_sha256
SELECT * FROM transcript WHERE path_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{path}, 256)) AND path=#{path}
SELECT id, parse_status, raw_text FROM transcript_item WHERE transcript_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY generation, byte_offset
mapper.update: UPDATE transcript SET configured_path=#{configuredPath}, canonical_path=#{canonicalPath}, path_status=#{pathStatus}, session_meta_item_id=#{sessionMetaRecordId}, meta_session_id=#{jsonlSessionId}, session_check_status=#{sessionCheckStatus}, adapter_version=#{adapterVersion}, checked_at=#{checkedAt}, revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{sourceFileId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id, t.configured_path, t.canonical_path, t.path_status, t.id source_file_id, t.session_meta_item_id session_meta_record_id, t.meta_session_id jsonl_session_id, t.session_check_status, t.adapter_version, t.checked_at FROM transcript t JOIN execution_session s ON s.transcript_path=t.configured_path OR s.transcript_path=t.canonical_path ORDER BY t.checked_at DESC, t.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trace_transcript_evidence_link( transcript_item_id,target_type,session_id,turn_id,tool_use_id,content_kind,call_id, level,evidence_json,algorithm_version,content_text) SELECT #{supplement.rawRecordId}, 'TURN', t.session_id, t.turn_id, NULL, #{supplement.contentKind},#{supplement.callId},#{supplement.mappingLevel},#{evidenceJson}, #{supplement.adapterVersion},#{supplement.contentText} FROM execution_turn t WHERE #{supplement.hookNodeType}='TURN' AND t.turn_id=#{supplement.hookNodeId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_turn c WHERE c.turn_id=#{supplement.hookNodeId})=1 UNION ALL SELECT #{supplement.rawRecordId}, 'TOOL_CALL', c.session_id, c.turn_id, c.tool_use_id, #{supplement.contentKind},#{supplement.callId},#{supplement.mappingLevel},#{evidenceJson}, #{supplement.adapterVersion},#{supplement.contentText} FROM execution_tool_call c WHERE #{supplement.hookNodeType}='TOOL' AND c.tool_use_id=#{supplement.hookNodeId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_tool_call x WHERE x.tool_use_id=#{supplement.hookNodeId})=1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=trace_transcript_evidence_link.id
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, CASE WHEN s.target_type='TOOL_CALL' THEN 'TOOL' ELSE 'TURN' END hook_node_type, COALESCE(s.tool_use_id,s.turn_id) hook_node_id, s.transcript_item_id raw_record_id, s.content_kind, s.call_id, s.level mapping_level, s.algorithm_version adapter_version, s.content_text, r.raw_text raw_json FROM trace_transcript_evidence_link s JOIN transcript_item r ON r.id=s.transcript_item_id WHERE s.turn_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{turnId}, 256)) AND s.turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY r.event_time, r.id, s.id
